biocs.name: Rare unsigned process execution by scheduled task
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned process execution triggered by schtasks.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'schtasks.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'signed.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'
